text: To address this question and optimize addiction treatment, a comprehensive theoretical construct of human motivation, strongly supported by clinical data, is needed. Such a framework is currently somewhat lacking. In this manuscript, an updated version of Freudian Drive Theory is proposed to describe all forms of addiction. This revised theory posits that all addictions stem from a deficit of a specific signaling molecule, and the addictive behavior is executed as an attempt to compensate for this deficit. Since the theory´s predictions are underpinned by experimental clinical data, the updated Freudian Drive Theory may serve as a useful tool for clinical therapists.
source_label: Give me five! A modern perspective on addiction from the up-dated Freudian drive theory
